decisions.statement: A sentence ends at a terminal mark.
A sentence ends at a blank line.
A sentence ends at the end of the text.
A word keeps the offsets that word had in the whole document.
A contraction is split into two words.
A word is lowered before that word is encoded.
An accent is dropped before a word is encoded.
A word the pieces do not cover is encoded as the unknown piece.
A sentence wider than the model is split into chunks.
No word is dropped for falling past the model's width.

definition: the pieces a text is split into before a model reads it
